test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following rivers originates from Aravalli range and disappears into Rann of Kachchh?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Luni.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The Luni is the** largest river **in **northwest India's Thar Desert.**
 
• It begins in the **Pushkar valley of the Aravalli Range**, close to Ajmer, travels** 495 kilometers** through the southern Thar Desert, and then ends in the marshlands of** Rann of Kutch in Gujarat.**
 
• Prior to meeting its **tributary Sarasvati**, which rises from Pushkar Lake, it was known as **Sagarmati**. After passing **Govindgarh,** it became known as** Luni.**
 
• Due to the** excessive salinity** of its water, the Luni is often referred to as the** Lavanavari or Lavanavati,** which in Sanskrit means** "salt river."**
 
• The **Jawai, Sukri, Guhiya, Bandi and Jojari **rivers are the** main tributaries** of Luni river. 
 
• **Dantiwada, Sipu, and Jaswant Sagar dams** are located on the Luni River.
 
• **Maharaja Jaswant Singh** completed the Jaswant Sagar Dam in **1892.** It is one of the **largest artificial lakes **in India.
 
• **Sardar Samand and Jawai Dam** are the two principal** irrigation projects** on the Luni River.**​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5ecb4f8e77a5dfc48388ca3edde7ca67a5476aaf95b35516c16d72660828a9ac.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chambal:**

 
 
• In Central and Northern India, the Chambal River is a** tributary of the Yamuna River **and is thus a part of the larger Gangetic drainage system.
 
• The river travels **north-northeast **through the state of** Madhya Pradesh**, briefly traversing **Rajasthan**, marking the border between the two states, and then turning** southeast** to join the Yamuna in the state of **Uttar Pradesh.**
 
 
 
• **Sabarmati:**
 
 
• One of India's main** west-flowing rivers** is the Sabarmati.
 
• It begins in the **Aravalli Range of the Udaipur **District of Rajasthan and, after traveling **371 kilometers **in a south-westerly direction across Rajasthan and Gujarat, reaches the **Gulf of Khambhat of the Arabian Sea.**
 
 
 
• **Banas:**
 
 
• The Banas is a river that flows wholly through the **western Indian state of Rajasthan.**
 
• It is a** branch of the Chambal River,** which is a branch of the **Yamuna **and joins the Ganga.
 
• The length of the Banas is roughly **512 kilometers.**
